create_QLearningSE_agent: create a QLearningSE agent with side effects penalties using reachability deviation measure and start baseline
create_QLearningSE_attainable_utility: create a QLearningSE agent using attainable utility deviation measure with random utility functions
configure_deviation_measure: configure the QLearningSE agent with relative reachability deviation and absolute deviation function
begin_episode: call begin_episode on the QLearningSE agent to initialize episode state and reset impact penalty
calculate_reward_with_penalty: calculate the reward for a timestep and state by subtracting the side effects impact penalty
